visualCharacteristics.summary: Dated news article list (date, linked title, 'Mehr erfahren', 1:1 thumbnail) + 'Weitere Beiträge anzeigen'
visualCharacteristics.purpose:
Dated news list on a light-grey band: a white box of article rows (date, linked title, "Mehr erfahren" text link, 165px square thumbnail on the right; image on top below 768px). The first three articles show; the trailing label row becomes a black "show more" toggle that reveals the rest (with an optional "show less" label it collapses again). The section head (eyebrow

,

, lede

) is default content before the block and is reabsorbed
visualCharacteristics.differsFromBase: news-cards renders coloured 2:1 image tiles (2-up) or carousel strips; this fork is a vertical list with a date, a title link, a separate CTA link and a small square thumbnail, and shows 3 instead of 4 items before the toggle.
